class.name: BehaviorStateMachine
class.brief_description: Keeps one of its BehaviorState children active, and switches between them.
class.description:
Add [BehaviorState] nodes as children: the machine starts in [member initial_state] (or its first state), updates the active one every tick, and switches when a state calls [method BehaviorState.transition_to] or an event has a transition: [codeblock] func _ready(): $StateMachine.add_transition("Patrol", "Chase", "spotted") $StateMachine.add_transition("", "Flee", "hurt") # From any state.
func _on_vision_spotted(body): $StateMachine.blackboard["target"] = body $StateMachine.send_event("spotted") [/codeblock] A machine is a state too, so one can be a state of another: a "Combat" machine with "Strike" and "Dodge" states, inside one with "Patrol" and "Combat". Its own states run while it's active. Events go to the deepest active machine first, then outwards.

method.name: add_transition
method.description: Switches from [param from] (empty for any state) to [param to] when [param event] is sent. If [param guard] is set, the switch only happens when it returns [code]true[/code]. The first matching transition added wins.

method.name: change_state
method.description: Switches to [param state], a state's name or a path to it from the machine. Switching to the active state starts it again.

method.name: tick
method.description: Updates the active state with [param delta]. Call it yourself with [constant UPDATE_MANUAL].

members.member: The state the machine starts in. Its first state if not set.
Whether the outermost machine ticks. The active state stays active while it's off.
When the outermost machine ticks: see [enum UpdateMode]. Machines inside another tick with it.

signal.name: state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the machine switches state, from [param from] (null when it starts) to [param to].

constants.constant: Only when the game calls [method tick].
